description.narrative: The International Trans Fund (ITF) is a global participatory grantmaker that is exclusively dedicated to supporting trans-led groups to secure rights for trans people and improve the lived realities of trans individuals. The ITF mobilizes and facilitates sustainable resources for strong, trans-led movements and collective action, and aims to address and eliminate funding gaps impacting trans groups across the globe. The main pillars of their programming are participatory grantmaking, capacity building, institutional strengthening, and philanthropic advocacy in order to increase safety and liberation for trans people worldwide.
